title: The Standing Ovation for Nothing
skyStory: Thirty percent lit and still lounging in Leo, the crescent moon has decided it deserves applause. For what? For being a crescent. Leo agrees. The stars clap politely. Saturn claps slowly, which might be sarcastic, but might not. The moon bows anyway, three times, and blows kisses at the planets in the back row.

reading: Today you get a standing ovation. Not for anything in particular. Not for a finished project, a fixed problem or a perfect speech. Just for being a person who made it to Wednesday. Leo says that is enough.

This will feel strange. Your inner giver wants to hand the applause to someone else. Do not. Sit in the cabin's best chair, imagine the crowd on its feet, and let it roll over you for one full minute. [[The Sun]] reversed says stop earning joy and allow it: you are allowed to be celebrated for existing.
joel.mission: Stand up after finishing any task today, however small, and bow deeply to an imaginary crowd.
joel.omen: Clapping from somewhere out of sight. It is for you. Do not check; just accept it.

reading: The Wood Rat is always the first to notice when someone else deserves applause. Today, reverse it. Look at your own last week as if it belonged to a friend. You did a lot. You fixed a thing quietly. You carried something heavy without complaining.

Give yourself the ovation you would give her. Out loud, if possible. Saturn will grumble that this is not efficient. Tell Saturn to sit down; the show is starting. Around 7 pm, something will happen that feels like a gentle encore. Take that bow too.
nancy.mission: Write three things you did this week as if a friend did them, then read the list out loud with pride.
nancy.omen: A child cheering at nothing in particular. Join in silently; the universe counts that.
nancy.stoneWhy: one ring per round of applause

together.text: Mutual standing ovation hour. Send each other one sentence describing something the other person did recently that deserves a standing ovation. Specific is mandatory. Then each of you must reply with a thank you, and nothing else. No deflecting. Mars is timing it.
